description: Waste and Resources - Electrical and electronic equipment is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration de l'environnement. Annual report on waste electrical and electronic equipment. Coverage: Administration de l'environnement. The publisher named on the listing is Administration de l'environnement. Its keywords include waste, ressources, electrical-equipment, electronic-equipment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
